cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody got my meeting email. Don't resend anything; first we identify the communication failure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You didn't send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That is the immediate error, not the root cause. Why did nobody notice the office was waiting on one person?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it while you have lunch. Problem solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Temporary cover is not succession planning. Write down what else you'll take over while I eat; clearly we need to define your entire role.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 failure analysis, A3 root-cause correction and A5 succession distinction make minor email facts evidence of a wider organisational weakness.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 unsent draft causes A3 dependency concern; B4 routine cover causes A5 role-definition demand.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies the fix and B4 offers useful help plus lunch, so A enlarges an actual solution rather than an invented obstacle.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 one-off sending help trigger scrutiny of B whole role.

specificity.evidence: A1 missed meeting email and B2 draft status supply the small error; B4 lunch cover makes the final response legible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 role definition is a direct work request with a strained explanation of its supposed necessity.
